acceptance.desc: A1 成品MP4存在於 outputs/demo動畫/codex隊/demo_導覽動畫_Codex隊_20260710.mp4，ffprobe 顯示 1920x1080 h264

evidence.cmd: V="outputs/demo動畫/codex隊/demo_導覽動畫_Codex隊_20260710.mp4"; test -s "$V" && test "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name,width,height -of csv=s=x:p=0 "$V")" = "h264x1920x1080"
D=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "outputs/demo動畫/codex隊/demo_導覽動畫_Codex隊_20260710.mp4"); awk -v d="$D" "BEGIN{exit !(d>=15 && d<=20)}"

acceptance.desc: A3 含音訊軌（TTS老職工旁白），非靜音

evidence.cmd: V="outputs/demo動畫/codex隊/demo_導覽動畫_Codex隊_20260710.mp4"; test "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/ffprobe -v error -select_streams a:0 -show_entries stream=codec_type -of csv=p=0 "$V")" = audio && /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg -hide_banner -i "$V" -af volumedetect -f null - 2>&1 | grep -q "mean_volume: -23.4 dB"
